input.reasoning_summary:
After investigating potential challenges to the initial verdict, I found:

H1 (Restatements/Corrections): The counter-evidence (E12, E13, E14) discusses segment operating income and lease obligations but contains no mention of any restatements, corrections, or adjustments to the consolidated operating income or revenue figures for Q2 FY2027 ended July 26, 2026. NO_RELEVANT_EVIDENCE.

H2 (Non-GAAP adjustments): The counter-evidence (E15, E16, E17) describes segment reporting methodology and notes that "Other segment items" include various costs, but these are part of the segment-level reconciliation to consolidated results. There is no indication of non-GAAP adjustments or one-time items that would affect the GAAP operating income figure of $63,734 million used in the calculation. The segment operating income totals ($66,595M per E15) reconcile to consolidated operating income after corporate-level adjustments. NO_RELEVANT_EVIDENCE.

H3 (Preliminary/Estimated figures): The counter-evidence (E18, E19, E20) discusses operating income by segment, tax payments, and capital returns but contains no language indicating the reported figures are preliminary, estimated, or subject to change. These are filed financial statements in a 10-Q, which are reviewed or audited figures. NO_RELEVANT_EVIDENCE.

The evidence review confirms that E7 and E8 (XBRL facts showing operating income of $63,734M and revenue of $96,221M for the three months ended 2026-07-26) are marked as ENTAILS with EXACT_MATCH period compatibility and HISTORICAL_FACT statement time. The calculated operating margin is 63,734 / 96,221 = 0.6624 or 66.24%, which exceeds 60%.

No challenges were supported by the evidence. The initial verdict of SUPPORTED remains correct.
